courses.synopsis: The tractor power transmission system. Tractor design and constructional features, stability analysis/mechanics of farm tractor chassis. Traction theory, human factors in tractor design and utilization, the tractor hydraulic system. Performance, operation and testing of agricultural power units. Tractor selection, utilization and preventive maintenance. Tractor power cost estimation.
